admin.keys.title: Keys
admin.keys.lead: Named values for sdd_get_key. Callers look up by key_name; the store returns key_value in plaintext.
admin.keys.empty: No keys yet. Add one for MCP callers.
admin.keys.name: Name
admin.keys.name_hint: English only: letters, digits, underscore, hyphen. Must be unique. Used by sdd_get_key.
admin.keys.value_hint: Usually a long AI API key. Stored in the database; shown on the list for signed-in admins.
admin.keys.created_lead: The key is in the store. You can copy the value from the list anytime.
admin.keys.created_warn: Do not put this value in client logs or public responses.
admin.keys.delete_body: sdd_get_key for this name will return not_found.
errors.key_name_taken: That name is already in use.
errors.key_name_invalid: Use English letters, digits, underscore, or hyphen only.

admin.settings.lead: One repository URL for the read-only framework sync.

admin.guide.title: MCP instructions
admin.guide.lead: How to call framework.sdd.works. The server id is framework.sdd.works. Callers send a bearer token. Key values come from sdd_get_key.
admin.guide.tools_intro: HTTP and stdio share the same core. Descriptions include failure modes.
admin.guide.stdio_body: Local desktop clients (Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code) run the stdio binary. Install and update write the caller’s skill and rule paths.
admin.guide.http_body: Remote clients use https://framework.sdd.works/mcp with Authorization: Bearer. HTTP install does not write the server disk.
